title: SCE 2.4 Preventive Probe: Network Policy Blocking IMDS Access
description: Validates that the preventive control (iptables network policy per ADT Node 2.1) successfully blocks container processes from accessing the EC2 Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) endpoint at 169.254.169.254. This experiment creates an EC2 instance with iptables rules that block IMDS access for a specific UID (simulating container isolation), executes both attack steps 1.3 (T1562.001 - weaken IMDS configuration) and 2.3 (T1552.005 - access IMDS from container), and verifies that the network policy prevents credential exfiltration via the metadata endpoint while still allowing legitimate management access from root. The experiment tests both IMDSv1 and IMDSv2 scenarios and validates defense-in-depth by confirming that the network-level blocking works regardless of IMDS configuration changes.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Network policy blocks container process IMDS access (IMDSv1 and IMDSv2) while allowing root access
